items.title: Commission refers Ireland, Spain, France and the Netherlands to the Court of Justice over NIS2 transposition
items.title_zh: 欧委会将爱尔兰、西班牙、法国和荷兰的 NIS2 案件转交欧盟法院
items.summary: Public referral decision covering four Member States that had not notified full transposition measures.
items.summary_zh: 公开转交决定覆盖 4 个尚未通知完整转置措施的成员国。

items.title: Commission calls on 19 Member States to fully transpose the NIS2 Directive
items.title_zh: 欧委会向 19 个成员国发出理由意见，要求完成 NIS2 转置
items.summary: Reasoned opinion batch recorded as a historical infringement-procedure stage for 19 Member States.
items.summary_zh: 记录 19 个成员国的历史理由意见批次，作为正式程序阶段保存。

items.title: Commission calls on 23 Member States to fully transpose the NIS2 Directive
items.title_zh: 欧委会向 23 个成员国发出正式通知，要求完成 NIS2 转置
items.summary: Formal-notice batch opened infringement procedures after the 17 October 2024 transposition deadline.
items.summary_zh: 在 2024 年 10 月 17 日转置期限后启动 23 国正式通知程序。
